description: Source file implementing the Network Management (NM) interface as part of the Arctic Core AUTOSAR platform. It defines functions for NM initialization, state management, network requests, passive startup, and various network event notifications, with bus-specific handling via conditional compilation.

methods.name: void Nm_Init(const Nm_ConfigType * const nmConfigPtr)
methods.description: Initializes the NM interface with the provided configuration pointer.

methods.name: void Nm_GetVersionInfo(Std_VersionInfoType * nmVerInfoPtr)
methods.description: Returns version information of the NM module.

methods.name: Nm_ReturnType Nm_PassiveStartUp(const NetworkHandleType NetworkHandle)
methods.description: Starts NM passively on the specified network handle, calling the bus-specific passive startup function.

methods.name: Nm_ReturnType Nm_NetworkRequest(const NetworkHandleType NetworkHandle)
methods.description: Requests the network on the specified handle, calling the bus-specific network request function.

methods.name: Nm_ReturnType Nm_NetworkRelease(const NetworkHandleType NetworkHandle)
methods.description: Releases the network on the specified handle, calling the bus-specific network release function.

methods.name: Nm_ReturnType Nm_DisableCommunication(const NetworkHandleType NetworkHandle)
methods.description: Disables communication on the specified network handle via the bus-specific function.

methods.name: Nm_ReturnType Nm_EnableCommunication(const NetworkHandleType NetworkHandle)
methods.description: Enables communication on the specified network handle via the bus-specific function.

methods.name: Nm_ReturnType Nm_SetUserData(const NetworkHandleType NetworkHandle,const uint8 * const nmUserDataPtr)
methods.description: Sets user data for the next NM message transmitted, calling bus-specific function if user data is enabled.

methods.name: Nm_ReturnType Nm_GetUserData(const NetworkHandleType NetworkHandle,uint8 * const nmUserDataPtr,uint8 * const nmNodeIdPtr)
methods.description: Retrieves user data and node identifier from the last received NM message, calling bus-specific functions.

methods.name: Nm_ReturnType Nm_GetPduData(const NetworkHandleType NetworkHandle,uint8 * const nmPduData)
methods.description: Retrieves the entire PDU data from the most recent NM message.

methods.name: Nm_ReturnType Nm_RepeatMessageRequest(const NetworkHandleType NetworkHandle)
methods.description: Requests the repetition of a NM message on the bus.

methods.name: Nm_ReturnType Nm_GetNodeIdentifier(const NetworkHandleType NetworkHandle,uint8 * const nmNodeIdPtr)
methods.description: Obtains the node identifier from the last received NM message.

methods.name: Nm_ReturnType Nm_GetLocalNodeIdentifier(const NetworkHandleType NetworkHandle,uint8 * const nmNodeIdPtr)
methods.description: Obtains the local node identifier configured for the network handle.

methods.name: Nm_ReturnType Nm_CheckRemoteSleepIndication(const NetworkHandleType NetworkHandle,boolean * const nmRemoteSleepIndPtr)
methods.description: Checks for remote sleep indication; currently returns E_NOT_OK.

methods.name: Nm_ReturnType Nm_GetState(const NetworkHandleType NetworkHandle,Nm_StateType * const nmStatePtr,Nm_ModeType * const nmModePtr)
methods.description: Returns the current state and mode of the network management for a handle.

methods.name: void Nm_NetworkStartIndication(const NetworkHandleType NetworkHandle)
methods.description: Callback indicating NM message received in sleep mode, starts network management.

methods.name: void Nm_NetworkMode(const NetworkHandleType NetworkHandle)
methods.description: Callback indicating network has entered operational mode.

methods.name: void Nm_PrepareBusSleepMode(const NetworkHandleType NetworkHandle)
methods.description: Callback indicating preparation for bus sleep mode.

methods.name: void Nm_BusSleepMode(const NetworkHandleType NetworkHandle)
methods.description: Callback indicating network has entered bus sleep mode.

methods.name: void Nm_PduRxIndication(const NetworkHandleType NetworkHandle)
methods.description: Notification that a NM message has been received.

methods.name: void Nm_StateChangeNotification(const NetworkHandleType nmNetworkHandle,const Nm_StateType nmPreviousState,const Nm_StateType nmCurrentState)
methods.description: Notifies a change in NM state.

methods.name: void Nm_MainFunction()
methods.description: Periodic function to process NM state, called cyclically if needed.
